summary.text: Michael Padilla is a Democrat who has served in the New Mexico Senate since 2013, representing District 14 in Bernalillo County.
Padilla sits on the Senate Finance Committee and the Senate Committees' Committee.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's member page lists Padilla's occupation as business owner.
Between sessions, Padilla chairs the New Mexico Finance Authority Oversight Committee and the Legislative Interim Committee Working Group and is a member of the Legislative Council.
